subject: Duplicate annual charge
body: Our company card was charged $4,800 twice for the annual plan. Please refund the duplicate charge. This unexpected cost is blocking our finance close.

subject: Question about a small fee
body: Can you explain the $12 processing fee on invoice 1842? The rest of the invoice looks correct.

subject: App down for the whole team
body: None of our agents can open the app. It has been down for the entire team since this morning, and we will miss today's order cutoff if it stays down.

subject: One report export fails
body: The CSV export button shows an error for one report. I can still view that report on screen, and the rest of the app works.

subject: Account locked
body: My account is locked and I cannot sign in at all. Please restore access.

subject: Update verification phone
body: I can still sign in. Please change the phone number used for two-factor verification.

subject: Downgrade at renewal
body: Please downgrade us from the annual Business plan to the monthly Starter plan at the next renewal. There is no rush.

subject: How to schedule a report
body: The new dashboard is great. Where do I click to schedule a weekly email of the sales report?

subject: Rude support last week
body: I am disappointed with the support I received last week. The agent was rude and did not follow up. I want this experience reviewed. I am not asking for a refund or a product change.

subject: Weekend support hours
body: What are your support hours on weekends, and which email should I use for general questions?
